Nothing matches "toddler underwater basket weaving" in Halton Hills, so I'm returning no picks.

- **No such program found.** I searched for the activity by name plus Halton Hills. The only "underwater basket weaving" results were a craft brand, a UCSD campus workshop, and an old teen aquatics program in New York. None of them is a toddler class in Halton Hills. I found nothing on the Town's own pages either.
- **Possible intent.** The parent may have meant a toddler water-and-craft class, or just swimming. I did not turn these into picks, because they are not what was asked for. They are real and may be worth a follow-up:
  - **Town of Halton Hills swim lessons.** 
Parent and Tot 1 is for 4 to 12 months, Parent and Tot 2 for 12 to 24 months, and Parent and Tot 3 for 2 to 3 years old.
 
The Acton fall schedule runs Saturday October 3 to Thursday December 3, 2026, at $86.22 for 9 lessons (30 minute lesson) for Parent & Tot to Swimmer 3.
 I did not tie a specific toddler class day and time to that fall schedule, and I did not read the Gellert fall grid.
  - **Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre, Parent and Tot, 18 months to 3.11 years.** 
Fall 2026 is a 14 (13) week session, September 12 to December 18, and the page says registration opens July 20th.
 The page I read had no class day, time or price.
